parsed_json.up: Select the first 200 metabolism records for Oryctolagus cuniculus. Join metabolism to compound_records on substrate_record_id to get the substrate compound, then join to molecule_dictionary for the substrate name and to compound_structures for canonical_smiles. Optionally join molecule_hierarchy from the substrate molregno to retrieve the parent compound name. Return canonical_smiles, substrate_compound_name, parent_compound_name, met_conversion, pathway_key, organism, and enzyme_name. Do not sort; preserve source row order.
